notes: getBrightnessForRender is ported as fx_brf/particles_live_light (World.getLightBrightnessForSkyBlocks at the particle's box, once per tick) in particles_live.c. lane/particles2: the base constructor now spends exactly Entity's draws (entity ID, one seeder long, the UUID) and leaves prevPos at 0 (it sets lastTickPos); the old live code drew one seeder long too many and set prevPos. lane/idxlast 2026-09-27: every subclass with a spawner in reach is built live (particles_live.c); fx_client and the other fx_* scenes compare them field by field.
